questions.de: Welches Unternehmen hatte als erstes eine Online-Videothek und revolutionierte so die Art und Weise, wie wir zu Hause Filme anschauen?
questions.en: Which company was the first to run an online video rental store, revolutionising the way we watch films at home?

timeline.labelEn: Netflix is founded by Marc Randolph and Reed Hastings as a DVD rental service
timeline.labelDe: Netflix wird von Marc Randolph und Reed Hastings als DVD-Verleih gegründet

questions.notes: The card's intended answer; Netflix launched its online DVD rental site on 14 April 1998. 'First' is the card's claim and is loosely true at best.

questions.de: Welches junge Technologieunternehmen wollten die Gründer Larry Page und Sergey Brin 1999 für 750.000 US-Dollar verkaufen?
questions.en: Which young technology company did its founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin want to sell for 750,000 US dollars in 1999?

timeline.labelEn: Page and Brin offer to sell Google to Excite, which turns it down
timeline.labelDe: Page und Brin bieten Google dem Portal Excite zum Kauf an, das ablehnt

questions.notes: They first asked Excite for $1 million; Vinod Khosla talked them down to $750,000, and Excite's CEO George Bell still declined.
